reviews.reason: This surface has no new writer or product semantics. Shared bundle/source is rebuilt; existing inline and powcat contracts remain backward compatible. Optional canonical dependency evidence does not change existing Files/Code results, payments, ownership or historical records. Growth-only addition: No writer, node admission, replay, API, database, protocol or live-accounting change. The display-only Growth module is not consumed by this surface or dependency. Existing pending, confirmed and reorg evidence remains unchanged; no production records are rewritten. Mail bond restoration is writer routing only: canonical bond/WORK wire records, existing node admission, readers, indexing/replay, pending/confirmed/reorg handling and exactly-once economics are unchanged. Replies/files and other product writers retain their existing paths. Retained emergency and retention obligations: No target-specific writer, route or UI component changes; compatibility still depends on coherent canonical readers and readiness. Historical emergency baseline: the oracle-only correction from live e2669bc excluded linked Publish/Boost, Growth-model and Mail-composer changes; this combined successor includes those features while retaining the following emergency obligations. At and after block 975611 accepted INCB bonds require an authenticated predecessor summary witness binding the exact DNS overlay, raw opening commitment and canonical predecessor. Recipient-aggregate rounding and shared-transfer frozen valuation follow the existing H-minus-one rule. Previously committed transitions and pre-boundary replay remain unchanged; the raw accumulator does not receive DNS value and movements/fees must not be counted twice. Missing, stale or conflicting witness evidence fails closed. See audits/2026-11-12-incb-h-minus-one-oracle.md for evidence and limitations. Retained baseline liveCheck is only an existing activity regression gate, not oracle qualification: isolated physical-database materialization, actual-block replay, historical byte parity, canonical readiness/status and post-cutover protocol parity remain mandatory separate gates. Existing native-storage runtime overlays and recovery artifacts must be preserved. This manifest does not assert deployment, complete audit assurance or live parity. Forward witnessed INCB projection binds its aggregate mint to the exact authenticated raw direct-recipient position; component validation proves cumulative recipient rounding without altering native records. The API pre-materialization projection now sets its canonical token-mint discriminator before strict binding; an actual API-mapping regression covers the previously missing kind without relaxing guards. Worker transition normalization revalidates and preserves the exact H-minus-one witness for both component consumers; captured API fixture qualification is an explicit separate gate. Source-envelope stability correction ignores unrelated directory timestamp/size churn above the source root while retaining ancestor inode, permissions, ownership and symlink guards and full in-tree identity/content checks; deterministic synchronous and asynchronous regression tests cover both acceptance and fail-closed cases.
